approved_payload.content: Greytown station commander Lt-Col TG Sithole was shot dead and Sergeant Gumede was shot in the arm in a gun battle on the R33 towards Msinga on the afternoon of Thursday 12 November, IOL and BNK News report from a SAPS statement. Police had responded to a business robbery at Lucky Supermarket in the Greytown CBD, where the shop owner was shot and injured and staff were assaulted; at least 10 suspects fled in a Toyota Quantum and were intercepted on the R33. Police shot two suspects dead, a third was wounded and arrested, and the rest fled on foot into the mountains. The map point is approximate: the Greytown town point, not the place on the R33.
